title: Cardinal Billing Account Additional-Premium Billing Charge by Size of the Additional Premium
content:
**Rule.** How the billing charge on a Cardinal Billing Account additional-premium bill is computed depends on the size of the additional premium (the additional premium received most recently on the account): when the additional premium is at least $75.00, the billing charge is the state billing charge plus two percent (2 percent) of the part of the additional premium above $75.00; when it is under $20.00, the billing charge is one half (0.5) of the state billing charge; otherwise the billing charge is the state billing charge itself.

## Decision matrix

| Additional premium | Billing charge |
|---|---|
| $75.00 or more | State billing charge plus 2 percent of the part above $75.00 |
| $20.00 or more, under $75.00 | State billing charge itself |
| Under $20.00 | One half of the state billing charge |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical state billing charge $4.00)

| Additional premium | Band | Billing charge |
|---|---|---|
| $19.99 | Under $20.00 | $2.00 |
| $20.00 | $20.00 to under $75.00 | $4.00 |
| $74.99 | $20.00 to under $75.00 | $4.00 |
| $75.00 | $75.00 or more | $4.00 plus 2 percent of $0.00, that is $4.00 |
| $175.00 | $75.00 or more | $4.00 plus 2 percent of $100.00, that is $6.00 |

The billing charge is not rounded at this point; for example, an additional premium of $80.33 gives $4.00 plus 2 percent of $5.33, that is $4.1066.
